en_how: A WebGL shader casts one ray per pixel and intersects four spheres and a ground plane analytically, computing hard shadows, a single plastic material with a hard-edged white highlight, a red-and-white checkerboard floor and up to three mirror bounces (the chrome sphere reflects a warped world) under a purple-to-cyan gradient sky; the opening shows green wireframes projected in Canvas from the same camera, then a scanline reveals the rendered frame row by row from top to bottom while the camera slowly orbits.
